justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-modeled enum with distinct, informative variants carrying relevant data (the offending value, char, or string), with no stringly-typed leakage.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants, no panics in library paths, and the two expect() calls have clear documented reasons referring to prior validation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with thorough doc comments on all public items, sensible derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq), and Display implementation matching std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Idiomatic use of iterators, match, derives, ? equivalents via map_err, and a clean greedy table-driven approach with no unnecessary cloning.
